extracted_text:
Half Adder

Definition: Half adder is a combinational logic circuit that adds two binary bits and produces sum and carry out as outputs.

A half adder accepts two inputs:

• A (First Binary Input)
• B (Second Binary Input)

It produces three outputs:

• Sum (S) = Sum(1) + Carry(0)
• Carry(0) = 0
• Carry(1) = 1
